lesson.grammar_point: adverbs of frequency and How often

listenings.text: Hello, and welcome back to the program. Here is some information about our meetings. We always meet online, on Google Meet. We usually meet every two weeks, on Monday. Sometimes we meet every week, when we have a big report. We never meet on Friday. Please read the document before the call. I usually send the document three days before. If you have a question, write to me. Thank you very much.

Hi, this is a short message about the reading group. We read one article every two weeks. The group is small: five people, and we always speak English. I usually prepare two questions for each article. Sometimes we invite a researcher, and then the meeting is one hour and a half. We never use the chat for long messages. See you at the next meeting, and have a good week.

extra_audio.text: Joice opens the calendar and sees the meeting. She reads the document three days before the call. She always writes two questions in her notebook. Sometimes she asks one question in the meeting. She never leaves the call without saying one word.
